description:
Zone-3 ดวงสมพงค์ (Figma 421:826): FIXED art (NOT user-data-driven — the opposite of Zone 2, ฟีม decision #3), replacing the empty gray ServiceSection('ดวงสมพงค์'). 2 cards + 10 elements animating in a 2s loop (2 rats + heart + 7 colleagues), a full-bleed bubble bg, exported radial/heart SVGs. Four silent-regression risks the pixels (not the className) own: (1) the 10-element animation is heavier than Zone 2 → a dropped prefers-reduced-motion guard janks low-end phones and is invisible to tsc/console — fixed: @media(reduce){animation:none!important;opacity:1} on all 4 classes; (2) a big/fat mascot covers a card title — fixed: content

z-10 > mascot cluster z-5; (3) an asset (bg/radial/heart/mascot) fails to paint — every className points at a committed file, mascot 404 → hero fallback 01.png; (4) the wide -mx mascot clusters + full-bleed bg push the page sideways — fixed: overflow-hidden section+cards, 0 page overflow-x @393/360/320. Teeth-proven (run-zone3-somphong.ts, executed 🟢): 10/10 animated els stop under reduce; both titles z>mascot; 14 imgs paint; 404→hero; no overflow @3 widths; mut-motion-runs (re-enable animation under reduce via higher-specificity → simulate dropped guard) → CAUGHT; mut-title-behind (title z below mascot) → CAUGHT. verify-the-instrument: (a) WITHOUT reduce the probe reads animation-name!=none so the stop isn't vacuous; (b) an injected broken reads naturalWidth 0 so the fidelity probe truly sees a missing asset. gate_layer=visual (computed-style + z-order + geometry). Performance: 10-element loop measured at 4x CPU throttle = p95 18.5ms / 0 long-frames (60fps, compositor-driven), control busy-loop spikes to p95 51ms (instrument verified). Real /v2 verified @ FE e98a82e + uncommitted zone3 working-tree (content-proof: ดวงสมพงค์ + 2 cards + 9 mascots paint on the real route, cannot exist on e98a82e's empty ServiceSection). Button/card destinations NOT wired (ฟีม decision #4). Did not touch Zone 1/Zone 2. ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-07 (goo · harness-tidy ใบ ข · on บอง’s ruling): the anchor named here was MOVED to harness/archive/ — nothing runs it (not CI, not an npm script), so the field was advertising a guard that does not run (the shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191). Rule: connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor FILE is kept in harness/archive/ (Rule 1 · Nothing is Deleted); to revive, wire it into CI first, then re-add enforced_by. WAS: harness/run-zone3-somphong.ts#mut-motion-runs
